title: Temporal uncoupling of radial glia lineage progression in cortical organoids.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Found two GEO (Gene Expression Omnibus) series by searching, since PubMed had no data links. GSE327468 (MADM-CloneSeq, where MADM is a two-colour mouse lineage-tracing method): I downloaded the exon count matrix (3.6 MB; 55,359 Ensembl genes x 287 cells) and the series matrix. The per-cell metadata has 69 clone IDs, 3 plates (96/96/95 cells), colour (181 green, 103 red, 3 NA), clone type (SN = 46 clones, N = 22 clones, 1 NA) and clone size. GSE326044 (10x single-cell RNA-seq): I read its file list only, 20 filtered_feature_bc_matrix .h5 files of 20-51 MB each (830 MB tar), covering organoid days D8/D13/D20/D25 (4 libraries each) and in vivo E10/E13/E16/P0 (one each).
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Only the abstract; the paper is paywalled with no PMC full text. I did not see what SN and N stand for (probably symmetric-proliferative/neurogenic vs neurogenic-only clones), any cell-type annotations, or the in vivo comparison clone counts. I did not open the 10x .h5 files, but filtered_feature_bc_matrix files from Cell Ranger (10x's processing software) carry no cell-type labels.

a1_downloadable.note: Both GEO series are public and download without login (checked: count CSV fetched, 10x file list read).

a2_label_is_a_column.note: In CloneSeq, clone type (SN/N) is a column, but it is one label per clone (69 clones). The 10x data has only sample-level day labels. Cell types and lineage fate would have to be built by clustering, which I did not check in the files.

a3_inputs_present.note: Gene-by-cell count matrices are present (checked for CloneSeq: 55,359 genes x 287 cells).

a4_units_stated.note: Raw integer read counts per gene (SMART-Seq v3, a full-length single-cell RNA protocol), with exon and intron counts in separate files.

a5_enough_rows.note: 287 cells in 69 clones (checked). The independent unit for a fate label is the clone, and 69 is far below the 400 needed even for classification.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: GEO lists 287 samples and the matrix has 287 columns (checked). I could not compare against the paper's own counts because the full text is paywalled.

a8_label_provenance.note: Clone type and size come from MADM imaging and counting, a physical measurement rather than a model output (per GEO metadata).

integration.partner_dataset: In vivo MADM-CloneSeq mouse cortex data from the same lab (not located here)
integration.bigger_question_one_sentence: Does a progenitor's transcriptome predict its clone's fate differently in organoids than in vivo? This is untestable with 69 clones.

controls.positive_control: Plate identity should be predictable from expression (batch), and colour (green/red) should be recoverable from the MADM reporter transcripts.
controls.external_validation: None located; in vivo clone data was not found in these GEO series.

honest_claim_h3: With 69 clones from one mouse ES-cell line, induced at one time point, the most a model could claim is that sibling neurons' transcriptomes separate two clone types in this one organoid batch. That is too few clones to train on.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use the gene expression of single neurons from labelled clones to predict what kind of clone (fate pattern) each came from.
plain_idea.train_on: Gene counts for 287 single cells (verified) from 69 clones in mouse cortical organoids.
plain_idea.predict: Clone type (SN vs N), scored by MADM fluorescent lineage tracing and imaging in the organoids.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Developmental neurobiologists would learn whether progenitor fate leaves a transcriptional signature in organoids. But 69 clones cannot support that claim.

ml_idea: Classify clone type from single-cell transcriptomes of clone members, holding out whole clones. Dead: only 69 clones and 287 cells.

effort.compute_note: Estimated from the 3.6 MB count matrix, which I loaded in seconds; nothing was timed beyond loading.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Count clones in the GEO series matrix: 69. Already done, and it kills the project.

verdict_reason: Fails A5 and A2. The lineage-labelled data has only 287 cells in 69 clones (checked in the GEO metadata). The larger 10x single-cell RNA set has no cell-level labels beyond a sample day that is confounded with the sequencing library, so any useful label would have to be constructed by clustering.
